metadata.title: ROS OCP Backend — Plan of Action and Milestones

poam-items.title: AU-01: Include user identity (org_id, username) in HTTP access logs
poam-items.description: HTTP access log middleware does not extract and include org_id or username from the X-Rh-Identity header. Only method, URI, status, and latency are logged.
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Configure middleware.RequestLoggerWithConfig with custom LogValuesFunc that decodes X-Rh-Identity and includes org_id + username. Code location: internal/api/middleware/request_logger.go.

poam-items.title: IR-01: Create incident response plan and runbook
poam-items.description: No incident response plan or security runbook exists in the repository. Required for FedRAMP IR family controls.
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Create docs/operations/incident-response.md covering detection, classification, escalation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review. Include runbooks for common scenarios (data breach, DoS, credential compromise).

poam-items.title: IR-02: Define Prometheus alerting rules for security events
poam-items.description: No alerting rules (PrometheusRule CRs or alert definitions) exist in the codebase for security-relevant events (auth failures, rate limit breaches, unusual access patterns).
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Create monitoring/alerts.yaml with PrometheusRule definitions for: sustained 401/403 rates, rate limiter saturation, unusual org_id access patterns, pod restart loops.

poam-items.title: IR-03: Implement security event classification in logs
poam-items.description: No structured classification of security-relevant events (authentication failure, authorization denial, rate limiting, input validation rejection) in log output.
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Add structured 'event_class' field to security-relevant log entries (e.g., 'auth.failure', 'authz.denied', 'ratelimit.exceeded', 'input.rejected'). Enables SIEM correlation and alerting.

poam-items.title: RA-02: Conduct third-party penetration test
poam-items.description: No third-party penetration test has been performed against ros-ocp-backend. FedRAMP requires annual penetration testing by an independent assessor (3PAO).
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Engage 3PAO for annual penetration test covering OWASP Top 10, API-specific attacks, and business logic flaws. Internal adversarial reviews (7 rounds completed) provide interim coverage.

poam-items.title: AU-03: Add opt-in verbose access logging for read operations
poam-items.description: Successful GET requests for recommendations are not individually audit-logged. High-volume read traffic makes full logging impractical without opt-in mechanism.
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Add ROS_VERBOSE_AUDIT_LOG environment variable. When enabled, log all successful read operations with org_id, endpoint, and result count. Default: disabled (performance).

poam-items.title: AU-04: Include username in structured log context
poam-items.description: Log entries include org_id but not the specific user_id/username from the identity header. Limits forensic investigation capability.
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Extract 'username' field from decoded X-Rh-Identity JSON and include in request-scoped logger context. Code location: identity decoding in internal/api/middleware/.

poam-items.title: CM-02: Implement secrets rotation mechanism
poam-items.description: No automated mechanism for rotating database credentials, Kafka SASL credentials, or S3 access keys. Manual rotation requires pod restart.
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: For SaaS (Clowder), credentials rotate via Clowder-managed secrets with pod restart. For on-prem, document rotation procedure in operations guide. Consider Kubernetes External Secrets Operator for automated rotation.

poam-items.title: RA-04: Establish formal annual security review cadence
poam-items.description: No documented schedule for annual risk reassessment, control effectiveness review, or security documentation updates.
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Document annual review schedule in docs/fedramp/README.md. Include: risk assessment refresh, penetration test, control effectiveness spot-checks, OSCAL artifact updates.

poam-items.title: AC-04: Document RBAC cache staleness as accepted risk
poam-items.description: RBAC permission cache (60s TTL) can serve stale permissions after revocation. Documented as accepted risk with bounded exposure window.
poam-items.remarks: Accepted risk: 60-second window is bounded and acceptable for non-safety-critical authorization decisions. Cache invalidation hook may be added in future if shorter window required.

poam-items.title: AC-05: Evaluate IP-based access restriction
poam-items.description: No IP allowlist or geo-restriction capability at the service layer. Relies on platform-level (gateway/WAF) IP filtering.
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Platform-level responsibility (3scale/Akamai/CloudFlare WAF). Document as inherited control if platform implements IP restrictions. Not needed at application layer.

poam-items.title: SI-02: Evaluate runtime application self-protection (RASP)
poam-items.description: No runtime security monitoring (RASP, eBPF-based anomaly detection) at application layer. Relies on platform-level monitoring.
poam-items.remarks: Platform responsibility. OpenShift provides runtime monitoring via StackRox/ACS (Advanced Cluster Security). Document as inherited if ACS deployed.

poam-items.title: SI-03 / CM-05: Generate SBOM in CI pipeline
poam-items.description: No Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generated as part of the upstream CI pipeline. FedRAMP and EO 14028 require SBOM for supply chain transparency.
poam-items.remarks: Remediation: Add 'syft' or 'cyclonedx-gomod' step to GitHub Actions workflow to generate CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM on each release. Attach as build artifact. Downstream Tekton pipeline may already generate via Konflux.
